transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I'm seeking help because I've been struggling with really distressing, intrusive memories and constant nightmares about a traumatic event that happened about a year and four months ago. It feels like I can't escape them, and they just keep coming back.
Have you found yourself actively trying to avoid thoughts, feelings, places, or people that remind you of this traumatic event?

Yes, absolutely. I do everything I can to push any thoughts or feelings about it out of my mind because it's just too painful to face. I also completely avoid the area where it happened and stay away from certain people or conversations that might trigger those memories.
Have you also been feeling constantly on guard, easily startled, or having trouble sleeping and concentrating since the event?

Yes, I feel constantly on guard and am always scanning my surroundings for danger, even when I know I'm safe. My sleep is also terrible—I have a really hard time falling asleep, wake up constantly throughout the night from bad nightmares, and never feel rested.
Since the event, have you noticed negative changes in your mood, or have you started holding negative beliefs about yourself or the world?

Yes, my mood has changed drastically, but it's more like I feel completely empty and emotionally numb inside. I can't feel happiness or joy even when good things happen, and I feel totally numb to love and affection from my family. I don't even feel any satisfaction or pride when I achieve something anymore.

latest_inference.note: The patient meets all DSM-5 criteria for Posttraumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), including exposure to a traumatic event, intrusion symptoms (intrusive memories, nightmares), avoidance behavior, negative alterations in cognitions and mood (emotional numbness, inability to feel positive emotions), and alterations in arousal and reactivity (hypervigilance, sleep disturbance). The duration of symptoms is 1 year and 4 months, which is well over the 1-month threshold required for PTSD. No other diagnoses are indicated, so we can finalize the diagnosis.
